thread:
Maria Chen: Kicking off Aurora Labs onboarding. Want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a rough timeline. Meeting proposed Tue 10am PST. Can folks confirm owners and any immediate blockers?
Devon Patel: I can own API integration + smoke tests. Tue 10 works for me.
Samir Gupta: I'll triage infra reqs (GPU quota / VPC setup). Can we get their expected peak rps and typical seq length?
Maria Chen: Good Q — Aurora expects ~40 req/s at peak, mostly short prompts (<=256 tokens). I'll paste the notes from the sales call in a sec.
Lee Morgan: Suggest a phased 3-week plan: week 1 API + auth + sample flow, week 2 performance tuning + canary, week 3 enablement + handoff.
Maria Chen: That matches what I had in mind. Success criteria proposal: 1) API integration complete and app calling endpoints, 2) Latency P95 <= 300ms on hosted Redwood plan or documented fallback plan, 3) Internal QA runbooks + training completed, 4) Customer satisfaction >= 8/10 on post-onboard survey.
Devon Patel: For auth, are they using OAuth or API keys? Need to know for the demo.
Maria Chen: Customer wants API keys for now, SSO in Q2. I'll confirm contact (Emily, their PM).
Samir Gupta: Noted on latency — with 40 rps should be fine on dedicated pool but will need routing policy set for region. I'll add a note: request dedicated capacity quote if they want <200ms SLO.
Lee Morgan: I'll schedule the enablement sessions: 2x 60m hands-on + 1x Q&A. Devon can run the dev session.
Devon Patel: Happy to. I can prepare a short repo + Postman collection.
Maria Chen: Risk callout: legal flagged data residency requirement (EU only). Sales is routing this to Enterprise. If we don't resolve by week 2, renewal risk increases.
Samir Gupta: For EU residency we should plan Private deployment or VPC in region. That affects timeline — adds ~7-10 days ops work.
Maria Chen: Action items:
- Maria: confirm Aurora PM contact + send meeting invite (due: today)
- Devon: prepare sample client + Postman collection (due: Tue before meeting)
- Samir: prepare infra checklist and estimate for EU VPC option (due: Wed)
- Lee: create enablement calendar invites and survey draft (due: Thu)
(onboard-bot): Meeting created: Tue 10:00 PST — link: https://meet.example.com/aurora-onboard
Devon Patel: +1 on survey — suggest 5 quick questions, include a free-text field for "integration friction".
Lee Morgan: I'll draft the survey and ping for reviews.
Maria Chen: I'll add success criteria to the kickoff doc and include renewal watch flags. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept owner tasks.
Devon Patel: :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: :thumbsup:
Lee Morgan: :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks team — we'll recap in the meeting and lock dates. If anything urgent before then, DM me.
